description: This PHP source file defines an event subscriber class 'ExceptionSubscriber' within the OrangeHRM project. Its purpose is to listen for exception events during HTTP request processing and to generate appropriate HTTP responses based on the type of exception thrown.

classes.name: ExceptionSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that listens for exception events in Symfony-based HTTP application, handling exceptions to set appropriate HTTP responses.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers the event handler for kernel exception events, with a priority of -65.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles exception events by generating HTTP responses based on the exception type.
